record.title: Acquire the live descriptor-bound FRAM baseline
record.intent: Close the stored private-state preservation gap before option installation.
requirements: Under fresh verified capture and host isolation, resolve the live CFram descriptor to its actual adapter and device identity; recheck stock process and module ancestry.
Execute at most one admitted two-image read acquisition; preserve exact raw results and compare the private region with prior caches. Stop on transfer failure, identity mismatch or disagreement.
Seal evidence and restore host state; do not install options or modify capabilities during acquisition.
acceptance: Stored FRAM evidence or a precise failure is sealed without a stored-data write.
